description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Pinnacle Monk
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
